subject: Request: Q4 headcount authorization for Runtime & Infra (3 roles)
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Q4 headcount authorization for Runtime & Infra (3 roles)

Hi Lauren / Markus —

I'm requesting authorization to open three critical engineering roles in Q4 on the runtime/infra team:

- 2 x Senior Infrastructure Engineer (backfill/expansion) — focus: autoscaling, storage/KV reliability, infra cost optimization
- 1 x Senior Runtime Engineer — focus: KV cache persistence, continuous batching changes and latency regressions

Why now: we have 25% growth in inference traffic on our hosted API month-over-month; current on-call and delivery velocity are saturated. These hires are directly tied to launch priorities (autoscale stabilization, cache durability) and to keep latency targets for top customers.

Proposed headcount & comp guidance (preliminary):
- Senior Infra (2): base $165k–$210k, target total comp (incl. bonus/equity) $200k–$260k
- Senior Runtime (1): base $175k–$225k, target total comp $215k–$275k

Location: US-remote preferred; open to hybrid in SF for final candidates.

Attached: HC_Rationales_Q4.pdf and comp-bands-Q4.csv with suggested band placement and salary comps from the recruiting team.

Ask: Please confirm if we have budget headcount authorization to proceed to req creation and candidate outreach. If OK, Marissa will share timeline and initial candidate targets (we already have one warm candidate from TalentBridge).

Thanks — I can join a quick sync if you prefer to discuss trade-offs.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Runtime Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Q4 headcount authorization for Runtime & Infra (3 roles)

Thanks Hannah — good context and clear asks. Two quick asks from People:

1) Can you confirm proposed level for each role (IC4 vs IC5)? That will determine comp bands precisely.
2) Please include expected ramp timeline and on-call coverage impact if we hire only 1 of the 3 this quarter.

Marissa — when you get the reqs up, please include estimated OTE for on-target offers and a quick market note against these bands.

Markus / Vivek — any early budget concerns? We should try to keep the top-of-band exceptions limited, but there's a candidate pipeline note in the doc that may need one-off approval.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of People (Talent & Comp)
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Q4 headcount authorization for Runtime & Infra (3 roles)

Appreciate the write-up, Hannah. I support moving forward with 2 hires immediately and evaluating timing for the 3rd against Q4 priorities — that gives us runway to absorb the work for autoscale and KV durability without extending on-call.

Quick internal note (copied here):
- If we reallocate any unspent contractor dollars (~$60k remaining in infra ops) we can fund a mid-band offer for one candidate sooner.
- If finance wants to pace, we can hire the two highest-impact roles first (1 infra + 1 runtime) and convert the second infra hire from contractor to FTE in Q4 if goal metrics are met.

Vivek — can you confirm if finance is OK with reallocation and the two/hire cadence? Also flag any reporting/req codes needed on our end.

> 
> > Can you confirm proposed level for each role (IC4 vs IC5)? That will determine comp bands precisely.
> > 
> > — Lauren
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Q4 headcount authorization for Runtime & Infra (3 roles)

Markus / Hannah —

Finance can provide conditional authorization as follows:

- Approve funding for 2 FTEs to start in Q4 (one Senior Infra + one Senior Runtime) using reallocated contractor funds plus partial hiring budget.
- The third Senior Infra role will be reviewed at the end of October; approval will depend on Q4 spend velocity and delivery metrics (SLOs on latency and autoscale success).

Comp bands we can authorize to post in Workday/ATS (max base):
- Senior Infra: $210,000 base (mid-band typical $185k)
- Senior Runtime: $225,000 base (mid-band typical $200k)

Notes:
- Any top-of-band exceptions (>90th pctile) need written approval from Lauren and EVP.
- Req codes: please use HC-ENG-2026-Q4-RTINF-01 and HC-ENG-2026-Q4-RTINF-02 for the two approved reqs.

I've attached a short budget note (hc_budget_note.xlsx) with the reallocation math. We can execute offers up to the mid-to-upper band for competitive candidates; please route exceptions to me + Lauren.

— Vivek
VP Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Q4 headcount authorization for Runtime & Infra (3 roles)

Thanks all — I'll open the two approved reqs today (HC-ENG-2026-Q4-RTINF-01, HC-ENG-2026-Q4-RTINF-02).

Initial market guidance and plan:
- We'll post Senior Infra at IC4/IC5 with a posted range that maps to the bases Vivek listed. For seasoned candidates we recommend mid-band offers first, with ability to go to upper-band for a hard-to-get hire.
- Candidate pipeline: TalentBridge has a warm candidate, Tim Greene (tim.greene@candidate.ai). He is a systems-heavy runtime engineer currently at a scale infra startup and expects a decision within 2 weeks.

Attached: candidate_tim_greene_brief.pdf and the offer_template_v2.docx.

Requesting Lauren / Vivek sign-off to submit a draft offer at mid-band for Tim (base $200k, expected OTE $240k). If you approve, I'll draft offer and send for comp exception if we need to go above $210k.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference

Marissa: proceed to draft the offer for Tim at base $200k (OTE $240k) and share the offer packet here for signatures. Let's target sending by Monday morning.
